Most CorpusA/remainingCorpusB native conclusions are author screening observations;no separate full independent item-level grading receipt was located. This final audit verifies their collection/provenance and conservative disposition,not every output anew.
No task-specific model superiority was established;native trials use Astra/high. Configured/catalog availability is not a comparative model win.
Public authored examples are not held-out evidence;only Pulse received new independent repeated confirmation here,and it did not confirm improvement.
